profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, and trades under the ticker SNAP. It is also recorded under the alias SNAP INC - A, and its SEC filing identifier is 0001564408. On its own website the company describes itself in broad terms rather than by product line: it says it believes the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate, and that it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The material available on the company's site does not name specific products or AI offerings, and no products are tracked for it. No lawsuits are recorded against it. Its recorded legal exposure is concentrated in California, with a count of 281. No MCP servers are associated with the company.
